Burn Shit: inventory destruction
Enable context-menu destruction

Adds Destroy and Destroy everything to the item context menu. Destroy everything is shown on every inventory item, including equipped and protected ones, and removes every eligible rucksack object except equipped, favorite or policy-blocked items. Every action requires confirmation.
Show Destroy everything
Always: the action is on every inventory item. Multiple: hide it when Destroy already covers the only eligible object. Equipped, belted, favorite and policy-blocked objects are never deleted.
Allow destroying quest items
Dangerous. Quest items can be permanently removed. A warning is still shown before confirmation.
Protect favorite items
Protects sections marked as Favorite by SortingPlus. The flag is section-wide, so every instance of that item type is preserved. Enabled by default.
Allow destroying untradeable items
Dangerous. Allows items marked can_trade = false; some may be story-critical without an explicit quest_item flag. Disabled by default.
Play burning sound
Plays a short sound after confirmed destruction.
